_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: latent 0.8 x treated + logistic noise, cut at -1, 0.5 and 2

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log odds ratio, standard error, interval and thresholds
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: up to 5e-9 with both optimizers tightened. At the defaults statsmodels' BFGS reported non-convergence and the two differed by up to 6.5e-5. harness/regression_examples.test.py checks against a direct maximization of the cumulative-logit likelihood and shows the alphabetical category order gives a log odds ratio of 0.35 against 0.98.

recovery.claim: the log odds ratio and thresholds are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Measured by harness/regression_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
